emails.subject: Receipt for household supplies - Jan 6
emails.body: Thanks for shopping locally. Your Jan 6 purchase of dish soap, matches, and two LED bulbs was paid in full at pickup. No items are backordered.

emails.subject: December cabin clean completed
emails.body: Cedar Lane Cleaning Cooperative completed the scheduled interior clean on December 29. The key was returned to the lockbox and there are no open supply notes from the cleaner.
